page: UpCloud GPU-16xCPU-192GB-3xL4 is a GPU-accelerated server instance built on the KVM hypervisor. It features an x86_64 CPU architecture with 16 shared vCPUs and 192.0 GB of system memory, yielding a memory-to-core ratio of 12.0 GB per vCPU.

The server is equipped with three NVIDIA L4 GPUs from the Ada Lovelace architecture family, providing a total of 72 GB of VRAM. There is no local storage bundled with this instance, meaning storage resources must be attached separately. It includes one complimentary public IPv4 address.

Given the shared CPU allocation combined with high-density memory and triple NVIDIA L4 GPUs, this server offers a specialized hardware profile for workloads that are highly dependent on GPU acceleration rather than dedicated, continuous CPU performance. It is suited for workloads such as machine learning inference, data science jobs, and graphics rendering where GPU memory and parallel processing are the primary bottlenecks.
